integrity: Analytic proof for infinite-time conclusions; exact-rational and numerical tests are supplementary. Priority independent confirmation remains outstanding.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to a precisely specified symmetric-initial-condition invariant set for row-stochastic networks with constant two-camp cross-exposure; it is not a claim of full-space attraction or resilience to heterogeneous perturbations.
title: A sharp cross-camp leadership threshold and universal algebraic relaxation
